'''Return to Geonosis''' is a featurette included in the Blu-ray and DVD release of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars The Complete Season Two|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' The Complete Season Two]]. It covers the development of the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series' [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|season two]] episodes "[[Landing at Point Rain]]," "[[Weapons Factory]]," "[[Legacy of Terror]]" and "[[Brain Invaders]]."

The featurette is divided into seven thematics:
*[[Landing at Point Rain]]
*[[Ki-Adi-Mundi]]
*[[Weapons Factory]]
*[[Barriss Offee]]
*[[Poggle the Lesser]]
*[[Legacy of Terror]]
*[[Brain Invaders]]
